name: 温德尔·斯坦利
bio_short: 美国生物化学家和病毒学家，1946年诺贝尔化学奖得主。他首次成功将烟草花叶病毒（TMV）结晶化（`stanley_crystallization_1935`），证明了病毒具有蛋白质的化学特性，从而模糊了生命与非生命的界限。
bio_short_en: An American biochemist and virologist, and a 1946 Nobel laureate in Chemistry. He was the first to successfully crystallize the Tobacco Mosaic Virus (TMV) (`stanley_crystallization_1935`), proving that viruses have the chemical properties of proteins, thus blurring the line between life and non-life.
